item.tib: don rgyud rgyas pa g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i cha lag shog chung
item.coloph: de ltar don rgyud rgyas pa g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi cha lag yig chung 'di lung bzang shel brag zhol gyi ri khrod du rgyal ba tshul khrims su 'bod pa'i klog 'don mkhan des brtsams pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
